1. Topic Title: Advanced SQL Queries
   Project: Query a real-world hospitality dataset to extract meaningful insights

  2. Topic Title: Data Visualization with Python (Matplotlib)
   Project: Create an interactive dashboard to visualize key performance indicators for a hotel chain

  3. Topic Title: Introduction to Machine Learning Models
   Project: Predict hotel occupancy rates using historical data

  4. Topic Title: Feature Engineering
   Project: Develop custom features from existing data to improve model performance

  5. Topic Title: Model Evaluation and Validation
   Project: Validate the performance of your machine learning model by using cross-validation techniques

  6. Topic Title: Data Storytelling
   Project: Craft a compelling narrative around your findings, including actionable insights for decision-makers in the hospitality industry

  7. Topic Title: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting
   Project: Create forecasts of future occupancy rates for hotels based on historical data and seasonal trends

  8. Topic Title: Job Application Materials (Resume, Cover Letter)
   Project: Revise your resume and cover letter to showcase your newly acquired skills and project work from the past 8 weeks
